what: Two UniProt accessions in the PHOENIX target table were wrong and had been asserted as correct.
method: Resolved every claimed accession against the UniProt REST API and checked the returned gene name.

errors.note: The first attempted fix (P42225) was also a guess and was also wrong. Only the API check resolved it.

pattern: Third occurrence in one session of a correctness claim made without a check (council verdict, parity metric, identifier table). The lesson is that anything asserted in the same sentence as a measurement inherits that sentence's credibility without earning it.
